scenario: Modulo `%` follows Python semantics per LEXP.7.6 — `Int % Int` is `Int`, `Float % Float` or mixed is `Float`. Negative-operand cases produce `5.5 % 2 == 1.5`, `-7 % 3 == 2` (Python sign). Pin: `where t.v % 3 == 0` compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` has no `lowered_contains`, so the modulo op is not read. The Python-sign result is pinned at runtime by runtime/LCON.2.6.2.
